title: Prior Attempts v1
description: Records failed exploration attempts so downstream agents avoid repeating them. Inspired by AI Co-Mathematician 'failed explorations as first-class records' (arXiv:2605.06651).

actor.description: Agent or lane that made this attempt

result.description: Outcome of the attempt (e.g., 'typecheck failed', 'approach contradicted by evidence')

do_not_repeat.description: Prescriptive guidance: what NOT to do again

useful_evidence.description: Evidence or artifacts from this attempt that may be useful despite failure
